newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Sunright - ING Barings.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Sunright - ING Barings.

text.p: Electronics-based Sunright Ltd hit a 1997 high of Singapore $1.76 on Tuesday following a buy recommendation from ING Baring Securities Ltd.
At 0841 GMT, the stock had eased to S$1.72, up 14 cents over its previous close. Volume was a moderately active 982,000 shares.
ING Barings investment analyst David Toh said he was upgrading Sunright to a buy from a hold because prospects for the firm would improve in line with a recovering DRAM market.
Toh said in a research report his price target for the share is S$2.00 based on 17 times July 1998 earnings.
"The share price has been consolidating and sentiment is improving," Toh told Reuters.
He said the market had been discounting poor earnings from the group in its first half ended January 1997.
Toh said he expected Sunright to report a four percent decline in earnings per share to 4.1 Singapore cents in the first half due to the under utilisation of the group's Taiwan testing facilities.
